t: This block will wirelessly send out a redstone signal on a specific channel when it gets a redstone signal. Use this in combination with the redstone receiver block. If you place this block down it will create a channel. You can also link this transmitter to existing channels by right clicking on another transmitter or receiver
当这个方块接收到红石信号时，它会在指定频道上无线发送一个红石信号。可与红石接收器方块配合使用。放置该方块时会创建一个频道。你也可以通过对另一个发射器或接收器右键，将这个发射器连接到已有频道。
Use a $(l:rftoolsbase:logic/redstone_receiver)Redstone Receiver$(/l) to receive redstone signals.$(br2)Using the GUI of this block you can give this channel a name which makes it easier to recognize
请使用$(l:rftoolsbase:logic/redstone_receiver)红石信号接收器$(/l)接收红石信号。$(br2)通过该方块的GUI，你可以为该通道命名，以便更轻松识别。
